goals.title: Implement the decided next work for Minions Bid after design decision...
goals.objective: Implement the decided next work for Minions Bid after design decisions: keep league schedule single route, keep match_days.matches array, keep current room read rules, enforce auction progress only while organizer and leaders are connected, and add operating latency observability for auction direct bid/event propagation with p95-oriented evidence. Use TDD, captured manual QA artifacts, and update project docs/checklist/context notes.

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use via Playwright. Run npx playwright test playwright/auction-realtime.spec.ts --project=chromium -g propagates
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/direct-event-playwright.txt plus cleanup receipt from Playwright webServer shutdown
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/direct-event-playwright.txt | cleanup: Playwright closed browser contexts and webServer exited; no LISTENING process on 3015

successCriteria.scenario: CLI data evidence. Run npx vitest run __tests__/latencyDebug.test.ts -t marker-merge and capture stdout to .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/marker-merge-vitest.txt. PASS iff marker merge and p95 summary test passes with no failed tests.
successCriteria.expectedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/marker-merge-vitest.txt plus cleanup receipt no runtime process spawned
successCriteria.capturedEvidence: .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/marker-merge-vitest.txt | cleanup: no persistent runtime process spawned

successCriteria.scenario: Browser use via Playwright plus doc CLI. Run npx playwright test playwright/auction-realtime.spec.ts --project=chromium -g pauses and capture stdout to .omo/ulw-loop/evidence/presence-policy-playwright.txt. Append rg output for watchdog and connected policy from README.md and doc/AUCTION_REALTIME_CONTRACT.md. PASS iff Chromium presence guard test passes and docs prove watchdog does not auto-progress when participants are absent.
